decisions.reason: As the flagship platform that anchors the firm's strategic direction and on which its plugins and extensions build, it is an option already being exercised, and dropping it would destroy far more value than it releases.

Mobile field data capture serves ongoing public-sector and utility demand and had its own page through 2019, so it costs little to maintain alongside the platform and still holds open upside, despite some uncertainty given the gap in website evidence.

The search extension was still being updated in 2019 (version 1.6.0) and complements the flagship ecosystem at low maintenance cost, though small plugins like A–C were already pruned, so there is a moderate risk it gets folded into the core product.
